title: The effects of acetamiprid exposure on osteoporosis: inducing imbalanced bone remodeling by disrupting the equilibrium of adipogenic/osteoblast/osteoclast differentiation.
authors: Song, Yanan; Yan, Yucheng; Liu, Feng; Du, Yunyun; Li, Yichao; Li, Yiman; Gao, Haoxuan; Wu, Bing; Hu, Yundi; Li, Xiaoyu; Yang, Huifang; Zhao, Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文研究农药ACE对骨质疏松的影响，虽用分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是PPARgamma小分子结合而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acetamiprid (ACE), a widely used neonicotinoid insecticide, has raised increasing concerns regarding its potential health risks; however, its effects on bone metabolism remain unclear. Here, computational toxicology, network toxicology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were integrated with in vivo and in vitro experiments to investigate the impact of ACE and its primary metabolite N-desmethyl-acetamiprid (N-dm-ACE) on bone remodeling. The results show that long-term ACE exposure significantly reduced trabecular bone mineral density and bone mass, impaired trabecular microarchitecture, decreased serum procollagen type I N-terminal propeptide (PINP), increased C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen (CTX-I), and elevated inflammatory cytokines. Network toxicology identified peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) as a key target, which was supported by stable binding of ACE and N-dm-ACE to PPARgamma in molecular docking and dynamics analyses. Mechanistically, ACE exposure upregulated PPARgamma and CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein alpha (C/EBPalpha) while suppressing runt-related transcription factor 2 (RUNX2), thereby promoting adipogenic differentiation and inhibiting osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs), while reducing the osteoprotegerin (OPG)/receptor activator of nuclear factor kappaB ligand (RANKL) ratio to enhance osteoclast differentiation. Silencing Pparg markedly reversed these effects. These findings demonstrate that ACE and N-dm-ACE disrupt bone remodeling through activation of the PPARgamma pathway, promoting osteoporosis.
abstract_zh: 啶虫脒（ACE）作为一种广泛使用的新烟碱类杀虫剂，其潜在健康风险日益引起关注；然而，其对骨代谢的影响仍不明确。本研究将计算毒理学、网络毒理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟与体内外实验相结合，探讨ACE及其主要代谢物N-去甲基啶虫脒（N-dm-ACE）对骨重塑的影响。结果表明，长期ACE暴露显著降低了骨小梁骨密度和骨量，损害骨小梁微结构，降低血清I型前胶原氨基端前肽（PINP），增加I型胶原C端交联肽（CTX-I），并升高炎症细胞因子。网络毒理学鉴定出过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）为关键靶点，分子对接和动力学分析中ACE和N-dm-ACE与PPARgamma的稳定结合支持了这一发现。机制上，ACE暴露上调PPARgamma和CCAAT/增强子结合蛋白α（C/EBPalpha），同时抑制runt相关转录因子2（RUNX2），从而促进骨髓间充质干细胞（BMSCs）的成脂分化并抑制成骨分化，同时降低骨保护素（OPG）/核因子κB受体活化因子配体（RANKL）比值以增强破骨细胞分化。沉默Pparg显著逆转了这些效应。这些发现表明，ACE和N-dm-ACE通过激活PPARgamma通路破坏骨重塑，促进骨质疏松。
